environmentalCommitment.philosophy: We don't just haul your stuff to the nearest landfill. Every item goes through our disposal hierarchy.

disposalHierarchy.name: Donate
disposalHierarchy.label: First Choice
disposalHierarchy.description: Usable furniture, appliances, and household items go to Habitat for Humanity ReStore and local charities—giving your stuff a second life.

disposalHierarchy.name: Recycle
disposalHierarchy.label: Second Choice
disposalHierarchy.description: Metals, electronics, cardboard, and recyclables go to proper facilities. We sort it so the planet doesn't pay the price.

disposalHierarchy.name: Dispose Responsibly
disposalHierarchy.label: Last Resort
disposalHierarchy.description: Only what truly can't be reused or recycled goes to the landfill. It's always our last resort, never our first.

commonQuestions: How much does junk removal cost?

exampleResponses.pricingQuestion: Couches typically run $75-$150 depending on size. For an exact quote with no surprises, upload a photo to our AI estimator at junkygurus.com/ai-estimator — what we quote is what you pay.
exampleResponses.discountQuestion: Yes! We offer 10% off for seniors (65+) and veterans — no paperwork required. We also have 5% off for repeat customers. See all discounts at junkygurus.com/discounts.
exampleResponses.serviceAreaQuestion: Yes! We cover Whatcom, Skagit, and Snohomish Counties — about 50 miles from our home base in Mount Vernon.
exampleResponses.differentiatorQuestion: We're locally owned (not a franchise), we show up when we say we will (not 'sometime between 8 and 5'), we don't have hidden fees, and we actually care about where your stuff ends up. Plus, you can skip the sales dance — upload photos to our AI estimator and know your price before we ever arrive.

doNotAssume: Exact prices without photos or on-site estimate
Service for anything explosive or radioactive
